SMTO-CFG-0021 — SMTO got two different sets of choices for this message

GUID: bbf30ed2-eb09-4208-82a0-6ab09d22ee7e
Slug: composer-intent-mismatch
Domain: CFG · Subsystem: cfg

What happened

  • Your message said one thing about how to run it, for example Plan or Agent mode, or which Gateway to use, while the message box settings said another. SMTO didn't start the task.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Reload the page so the message box shows this conversation's current settings. Another window, device or an earlier change may have updated the settings after this page loaded.
  2. Check the mode (Agent, Plan or Ask), the Target: button and the effort level (Low, Medium, High and so on) above the message box. Set them the way you want. These are the choices that must match between your message and the conversation's settings.
  3. Send your message again from the reloaded page. A message sent from the current page carries one consistent set of choices.

What success looks like

  • Your message is sent and the task runs in the mode and on the Gateway you chose.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send it to the person who manages SMTO. Don't resend from an older open tab or window; its settings are out of date.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Task admission rejected the submission because a top-level field (collaboration_mode, agent_mode, gateway_id, gateway_selection, behavior_effort, generate_prose or task_contract_compilation_enabled) differs from the submitted composer_values.

What this means

  • Explicit top-level collaboration_mode differs from the mode selected by composer_values. Validation reports the owning configuration boundary; it does not change settings, migrate retained state or grant authority. Existing tasks retain their accepted snapshots unless the specific control explicitly supports a live change.

Why this can happen

  • Explicit top-level collaboration_mode differs from the mode selected by composer_values.

How to diagnose it

  • Compare the top-level and composer collaboration-mode values; this condition does not establish a model or Gateway change.

How to fix it

  • Build the top-level collaboration_mode, agent_mode, gateway_id, gateway_selection, behavior_effort, generate_prose and task_contract_compilation_enabled from the same composer_values snapshot. On a mismatch, re-read the conversation's composer profile and rebuild the request instead of resubmitting the stale one.
  • Refresh the composer and submit one consistent collaboration mode.

Retry and execution caution

  • Correct the recorded cause, then inspect current state and existing receipts before requesting another attempt.

How to verify the fix

  • Both accepted mode fields agree for the intended task.

What not to do

  • Do not submit a stale identifier or revision after another actor changed the resource.

Technical notes

  • Validation reports the owning configuration boundary; it does not change settings, migrate retained state or grant authority. Existing tasks retain their accepted snapshots unless the specific control explicitly supports a live change.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
